description: Navbar + Hero + About + Skills sections. These are the first four visible sections of the portfolio, implemented as individual 'use client' components. Independent of FEAT-003 (bottom sections) but depends on FEAT-001's design system and data layer being in place. Each component imports from '@/lib/data' and '@/components/ui/*'.
steps: Create components/Navbar.jsx. Mark 'use client'. Import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'; import { Menu, X } from 'lucide-react'; import GradientButton from '@/components/ui/GradientButton'; import { PERSONAL } from '@/lib/data'. State: isOpen (mobile menu), scrolled (bool for bg blur). useEffect to listen to window.scroll — set scrolled=true when scrollY > 20. Nav links array: ['About','Skills','Projects','Services','Experience','Contact']. Render: fixed top-0 full-width z-50. When scrolled: backdrop-blur-xl bg-bg-primary/80 border-b border-border. Animate with motion.nav initial={{ y: -100 }} animate={{ y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}. Desktop: flex justify-between items-center max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 py-4. Logo left: gradient text 'CE.' or stylized monogram. Nav links center as anchor tags with href='#sectionid' lowercase. Each link has hover underline slide-in effect using motion.span absolute bottom bar. CTA button right: GradientButton size='sm' href='#contact'. Mobile: hamburger icon button toggles isOpen. AnimatePresence for mobile menu slide-down panel with full-screen overlay. Mobile menu items animate in with staggered delay.

Create components/Hero.jsx. Mark 'use client'. Import { motion, useScroll, useTransform } from 'framer-motion'; import { Github, Linkedin, Twitter, ArrowDown, Download } from 'lucide-react'; import GradientButton from '@/components/ui/GradientButton'; import { PERSONAL } from '@/lib/data'. Full viewport height section (min-h-screen). Background: deep dark bg-bg-primary with two large blurred gradient orbs (position absolute, rounded-full, blur-3xl, opacity-20) — one purple (accent) top-left, one teal (accent-secondary) bottom-right. These orbs animate with a slow floating keyframe (translate Y ±20px, 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate). Main content: centered flex column. Availability badge: small pill with green pulsing dot + 'Available for work'. Main headline: 'Hi, I am' on first line, name 'Chukwuebuka' as large gradient text on second line (text-6xl md:text-8xl font-display font-bold), third line shows animated rotating job titles using AnimatePresence — cycle through ['Frontend Developer', 'Full-Stack Developer', 'UI Engineer'] every 3s with slide-up/fade transition. Subtitle text from PERSONAL.subtitle. Short bio from PERSONAL.tagline. CTA buttons row: GradientButton primary 'View My Work' href='#projects', GradientButton outline 'Download CV' with Download icon. Social links row: icon-only links for Github, Linkedin, Twitter — each a motion.a with whileHover={{ scale:1.2, color: accent }}. Profile image placeholder: right side on desktop (lg:flex lg:items-center layout), a stylized div: 320x320 rounded-2xl with gradient border (border-2 border-transparent bg-gradient-to-br from-accent to-accent-secondary background-clip, inner bg-bg-card), contains initials 'CE' in large gradient text or a Next.js Image if a photo is placed at /public/profile.jpg — use Image with src='/profile.jpg' onError fallback to initials div. Scroll indicator at bottom: animated bouncing arrow or mouse icon. Parallax: use useScroll + useTransform to move the orbs slightly on scroll.

Create components/About.jsx. Mark 'use client'. Import SectionWrapper, AnimatedText, GradientButton from ui; import { PERSONAL } from '@/lib/data'; import { motion, useInView } from 'framer-motion'; import { MapPin, GraduationCap, Code2, Coffee } from 'lucide-react'. Wrap in SectionWrapper id='about'. Two-column layout (lg:grid-cols-2 gap-16) with left text column and right visual column. Left: section label ('About Me' in small caps, accent color, letter-spacing), AnimatedText headline ('Who I Am'), paragraph text with professional background — EE graduate from UNN, passion for building web applications, journey from engineering to dev. Four stat cards in a 2x2 grid: 'EE Graduate', '2:1 Degree', 'UNN', '2+ Years Dev' — each card is bg-bg-card rounded-xl p-4 with icon, number, label. Right: A decorative card stack — main card is bg-bg-card rounded-2xl p-6 border border-border with a gradient top border (::before pseudo via inline style), showing a stylized 'code snippet' text block (hardcoded JSX-like text in a monospace font with syntax coloring via span elements), and below it the tech tagline. Behind the main card: two offset shadow cards (absolute positioned, rotate-2 and -rotate-2, lower z-index, bg-bg-secondary). Cards entrance: staggered motion with x-slide from right.

Create components/Skills.jsx. Mark 'use client'. Import SectionWrapper, AnimatedText from ui; import { SKILLS } from '@/lib/data'; import { motion, useInView } from 'framer-motion'; import skill icons from 'react-icons/si' — map the icon string name from data to the actual import. Because dynamic import of react-icons is not supported in this pattern, create an inline ICON_MAP object at the top of the component: { SiReact: SiReact, SiNextdotjs: SiNextdotjs, ... } importing all needed icons statically at the top. Wrap in SectionWrapper id='skills'. Section header: label + AnimatedText headline 'Technical Skills'. Three category tabs or sections: 'Frontend', 'Backend', 'Tools' — render all three sequentially (no tab switching needed, just headings). Each category has a responsive grid (grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6) of skill cards. Each skill card: bg-bg-card hover:bg-bg-secondary border border-border hover:border-accent/50 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col items-center gap-2 cursor-default. Icon: render the react-icons component at size 32 with the color from data. Name: text-sm text-text-secondary font-medium. Framer Motion: each card has whileHover={{ y: -4, scale: 1.05 }} and initial={{ opacity:0, y:20 }} with staggered animate on inView (stagger 0.05s per item). Category label above each group: text-text-muted uppercase tracking-widest text-xs mb-4.
acceptance_criteria: Navbar renders fixed at top, changes style on scroll, mobile menu opens/closes
Hero section shows name, animated role titles, gradient orbs, social links, two CTA buttons
About section has two-column layout with stats and decorative code card
Skills section shows all three categories with icon cards from react-icons
verification: npm run build — must complete with exit 0 and no errors
